toast.notCollected: A not-collected cell has no events to filter by.
toast.structural: A structural edge has no events.
toast.pickGroup: Select a group chip to go into a child map.

table.partial: Map {name}: {k, number} of {n, number} events (other filters applied)
table.zero: Map {name} has 0 events, so there is nothing to filter

rules.title: No architecture map rules
rules.body: There are no rules (profiles) to draw the map, so it can't be drawn. Logs and run history still work.

noEvents.title: No events in this range
noEvents.body: The map is drawn from its rules. Numbers fill in when events arrive.

noSource.title: No cell can be filled
noSource.body: The log sources in this range ({kinds}) don't record any cell of this profile.
noSource.bodyNoKinds: The log sources in this range don't record any cell of this profile.

tooBig.title: Range too large
tooBig.body: {n, number} events exceed the map limit ({max, number}). Narrow the filters.
tooBig.bodyGeneric: The events in this range exceed the map limit. Narrow the filters.

runTab.explain: A map drawn from this run's platform records and the agent session logs. A call is counted once.

popout.openHelp: Detaches the map into a new window. It shares the log, selection, and highlights with this window.
popout.detachedTitle: The map is open in another window
popout.detachedBody: Selecting a cell there filters the event table in this window, and events selected here are highlighted there.
popout.pendingTitle: The map is set to open in a separate window
popout.pendingBody: The browser must allow a new window, so it isn't opened automatically.
popout.blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups in the address bar, then select "Detach to new window" again.
popout.unsupported: This browser doesn't support linking windows, so the map can't be detached.
popout.standalone: Not connected to the original window. Selecting a cell doesn't filter the log table.
popout.needArch: This server has no architecture map integration, so the map can't be drawn.
popout.needKey: This address has no range information. Open the map with "Detach to new window" from a log session or run detail.
